views.markdown:
**Feature-rich Tiktok Enhancer**

- No Ads
- Download Videos
- Download Musics
- Show/Hide UI button
- Copy video decription
- Copy video link
- Copy Music link
- Auto Play Next Video
- Show progress bar
- Confirm like
- Confirm comment like
- Confirm comment 
- dislike
- Confirm follow
- Save profile image
- Copy profile information
- Extend bio
- Extend comment
- Always open in Safari
- Changing region
- Fake verify blue mark
- Fake Follower count
- Fake Following count
- Padlock

- Added option to disable live broadcasts
- Added option to group menu items
- Added option to switch to compact downloading progress bar
- Added option to disable pull to refresh gesture in feed
- Added option to disable warning message under the video description
- Added "Fix Interactions" button in "Other" section to fix like, follow,
  comments and etc.
- Added downloading 'unavailable/removed' media support from your Favorites list
- Added japanese localization. Thank you to @SKEIDs
- Improved pure mode: keeps its state for all videos in feed
- Improved skip friends recommendation option
- Added iPad support for region changing (beta)
- Other slight improvements and bugfixes.
